Record source 'forward' predictions, local cell read/u/p/ns and analytic_bptt backward row dz,du, dg and local-role dr accumulators and future. Original source code unedited. Capture every backward row stage on the exact whole source episode, with row-level numeric checksum and float64 bytes hash.
observer_sensitivity: At original source update 3 Farama and update 8 Pycolab run ORIGINAL analytic_bptt() sequentially UNTRACED_PRE, then TRACED, then UNTRACED_POST before exactly ONE original Adam update from the first raw gradient. Record and compare triple exact gradient hashes. Observation ordering is a possible influence; do not claim instrumentation is inert.
first_cross_platform_difference: Compare exact ordered stage records for original source target update across Windows×2 and Ubuntu×2. Report first different (source,forward/or backward row, source step, primitive variable); NOT just whole gradient. Equal cross-platform raw gradient required for portable acceptance; no tolerance relaxation.

source_original_code_interface_contract.train_native: Read-only arithmetic mirror of exact original optimizer applied once per already-consumed episode; no original code mutation

No new hyperparameter, float32 or portable-kernel revision
No use of source-private labels or evaluator identity
